title: Pisces: your 2027,
three doors open.
summary: Late January, June and late November: the three turns of a Pisces year, what each one opens, and how to walk through it.
film: Pisces: the three months that change your 2027

inside: The three doors of your year, and the stretches between them
Work, love, money, energy, home and travel, one by one
All twelve months, with your best months marked
The dates that matter, and why the year reads this way
intro: If you are a Pisces by Moon sign, you have been carrying something heavy since the spring of 2025. 2027 is the year that weight starts to share the room with good news. The tradition reads three clear turns in your year, and each one opens a door: one in late January, one in June, and one in late November.

None of these doors asks you to become someone else. The first brings back the fun, the second gives you room to breathe, and the third brings warmth to your closest relationships. This guide walks you through each one, month by month, with what to do and what to leave alone.

chapters.name: Getting your house in order
chapters.text: The year opens where 2026 left off: luck sits in your house of daily work, and the long, steady pressure is still on your own sign. These three weeks are practical. They are read as good for clearing small tasks, fixing a routine and getting your body and your diary ready for what comes next.
chapters.do: Finish one lingering job, tidy your space, and get to bed on time.
chapters.avoid: Judging the whole year by how tired you feel in early January.

chapters.name: The fun comes back
chapters.text: Luck moves into your house of joy, and it is in the sign where the tradition says it is strongest. Romance, play, children, hobbies and anything you make with your hands are all read as favoured. You may notice you laugh more easily and want to create again. The heavier influence is still on your sign, so you will not feel weightless, but you will feel lighter.
chapters.do: Say yes to dates, invitations and creative projects. Start the thing you have been saving for someday.
chapters.avoid: Turning every pleasure into a duty. Let some of it just be fun.

chapters.name: Room to breathe
chapters.text: For the first time since March 2025, the planet of patience and effort steps off your sign and into your house of money and family. This is read as a real breather: your head clears and you have more space to think. Money and family matters ask for steady attention instead, which is easier to give than the old weight. Until June 24 luck is still in your house of joy, so early June is one of the sweetest stretches of your year. From June 25 luck moves to your house of daily work, a good season for habits that stick.
chapters.do: Rest properly, look at your budget calmly, and build one daily habit you want to keep for years.
chapters.avoid: Filling every free hour the moment the pressure lifts.

chapters.name: One short return
chapters.text: The steady pressure comes back onto your sign for a final lap. It is short, and it is the last one: the tradition counts down to February 23, 2028, when it leaves for good. You already know how to carry it, and luck is still helping your routine, so this stretch is read as finishing well rather than starting over.
chapters.do: Wrap up loose ends, keep your routine, and plan something to look forward to.
chapters.avoid: Reading the return as a step backwards. It is the end of the road, not the start.

chapters.name: Love gets a lift
chapters.text: Luck reaches your house of partners. Marriage, close partnerships and one-to-one relationships of every kind are read as warmly supported. If you are with someone, this is a good time to plan together; if you are single, people who could matter tend to come closer. It is a generous way to end a year that started with so much to carry.
chapters.do: Make time for the person who matters most, and be open to new people at year end gatherings.
chapters.avoid: Keeping your guard up out of habit. You can let people in now.

allYear: Your house of gains and friends is busy all year, which is read as new people and new sources of support arriving when you are open to them. Say yes to introductions.

areas.name: Work and career
areas.text: January and the second half of the year favour your daily work: routines, skills and being reliable are read as quietly rewarded. You do not need a dramatic move. Small, steady improvements from late June onward build a reputation that lasts, and your network keeps bringing new openings all year.

areas.name: Love and relationships
areas.text: Two of your three doors are about the heart. From late January to June, romance and play are lit up; from late November, partnership is. In between, keep things simple and kind. Single Pisces often meet people through friends this year, since your house of friends is busy throughout.

areas.name: Money
areas.text: From June 2 to October 18 the year’s steady pressure sits in your house of money and family, which is read as a time to get organised rather than a time of loss. Know your numbers, keep your commitments realistic, and you come out of it with firmer ground. Friends and contacts are read as a source of gains all year.

areas.name: Energy and wellbeing
areas.text: The first five months can still feel heavy, so rest is not optional. From June you are likely to feel your head clear. The daily work house is active for much of the year, which makes 2027 an excellent year to build health habits that you keep.

areas.name: Home and family
areas.text: Family matters ask for your attention from June to October, mostly practical ones: shared plans, shared costs, who does what. Patience and clear conversations go a long way. By late November the mood at home warms as your closest relationships take the spotlight.

areas.name: Travel and learning
areas.text: Creative courses and anything you learn for joy suit the first half of the year. In the second half, practical training that improves how you work fits better. Trips taken with friends are favoured all year.

months.text: Practical for three weeks: routines, health, small tasks. From the 24th the fun returns to your life. Notice what you want to make or play again.

Romance and creativity are lit up. A good month to start a hobby, plan dates, or spend real time with children in your life. If you have stopped doing something you loved, this is the month the tradition would pick to pick it up again.
Still bright for love and play. You may still feel tired at times; rest and joy can share the same month. Let one evening a week be only for something you enjoy, with no goal attached to it at all.

Keep going with what you started in February. Share your work with people who will cheer you on. Your friends are a strong source of support all year, so let them see what you are making and where you are going.

The last full month of the fun stretch with the old weight still on you. Enjoy it, and start making space for the change in June. Write down what brought you joy this spring, so you keep it going later.
From the 2nd, the weight steps off your sign. Early June has both the breather and the fun at once. From the 25th the focus moves to daily habits.

A clearer head. Look at money and family plans calmly, and set one daily routine you want to keep. This is read as the calmest stretch you have had in a long while, so use it to recover and to plan without hurry.

A steady, practical month. Good for work you do with care, and for getting your finances organised. Small improvements to how you work each day add up quickly now, and people notice that you are reliable.
Keep the habits going. Family conversations go better when they are about plans, not blame. Keep your evenings for rest, and you will reach the autumn with energy to spare for what is next.

On the 19th the old weight returns for a final, short lap. Finish things, keep your routine, and remember it is nearly over. You already know how to carry this; treat it as a closing chapter rather than a setback.

From the 26th your closest relationships are warmly lit. A lovely time to commit, reconnect or meet someone new. Be generous with your time and attention, and let other people be generous with you too.

End the year close to the people who matter. Plans made together now are read as having good support. Celebrate how far you have come since the start of the year, and the people who helped you get here.

dates.text: Door one: the fun comes back. Romance, play and making things are favoured until June 24.
Door two: the old weight steps off your sign until October 18. Room to breathe.
Luck moves to your daily work until November 25. Good habits stick.
A short last lap of the old weight on your sign begins.
Door three: love and partnership get a lift to end the year.
The long weight leaves your sign for good.

why.name: Jupiter, the planet of luck and growth
why.text: Jupiter is in Leo, your sixth house of daily work, until January 23. It moves into Cancer, your fifth house of joy and the sign where it is exalted, from January 24 to June 24. It returns to Leo from June 25 to November 25, then enters Virgo, your seventh house of partnership, on November 26.

why.name: Saturn, the planet of patience and effort
why.text: Saturn has been in Pisces, your own sign, since March 29, 2025: the middle and strongest phase of Sade Sati. From June 2 to October 18, 2027 it moves forward into Aries, your second house of money and family, then returns to Pisces on October 19 and leaves for good on February 23, 2028.

why.name: Rahu and Ketu, the Moon’s nodes
why.text: Rahu is in Capricorn all year, your eleventh house of gains and friends, a place where it is read as bringing new contacts and new ways to earn. Ketu sits opposite in Cancer, your fifth house, which is read as making you choosy about where you spend your time and your heart.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: I’m a Pisces Sun. Does this apply to me?
faq.a: Only if your Moon is also in Pisces. Many people with a Pisces Sun have their Moon somewhere else. Your birth chart shows it in a few seconds.

faq.q: Is my Sade Sati over in June?
faq.a: Not quite. The heaviest part steps off your sign from June 2 to October 18, 2027, returns for a short last lap, and Sade Sati's middle phase ends on February 23, 2028. The tradition reads June as your first real breather.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, read by Moon sign.
